title: Texas Housing Market Update March 2026
description:
Texas home prices are still trending down, with prices falling about 2% month over month and nearly 10% from the peak. In this March 2026 Texas housing market update, I break down what’s really happening across Austin, Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, San Antonio, and the Killeen-Temple-Fort Cavazos area.

I also take you inside a stalled neighborhood north of Austin that feels like a real-life ghost development—rows of unfinished homes, a completed model home, and no clear sign of construction starting back up. It’s one of the clearest physical examples of the Texas housing correction happening right now.

In this video, we cover:

Why Texas prices are still under pressure

Why Austin has been hit harder than other metros

Record-high inventory across many Texas markets

Why some sellers are being forced into price cuts, short sales, or bringing money to closing

Which Texas metros are still holding up better

Why this may be the best window for buyers to get a deal

Why sellers may need to act before spring competition rises

If you’re thinking about buying or selling in Texas, this video will help you understand where the market stands right now and what smart moves to make next.

I’m Stephen Harris, a Central Texas real estate broker, and I’ve been helping people make smart real estate decisions for around 10 years.
